content.text:
OPTIONS preflight from the `PUBLIC_URL` origin now returns 204 without `x-demo-key`. Actual workflow requests still require that header.

The demo-key hook was answering `OPTIONS /workflows` with 401 before any CORS headers were set. `@fastify/cors` is registered first and allows only the origin of `PUBLIC_URL` (`https://host` from that URL). Allowed methods are GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, and OPTIONS. Allowed headers are `content-type`, `x-demo-key`, and `accept`. A different `Origin` is not reflected.

Set `PUBLIC_URL` to the deployed frontend origin. That same value is still used for trigger URLs.

## TDD result
- Behavior: Browser preflight from the `PUBLIC_URL` origin succeeds without authentication. Authenticated workflow requests from that origin include `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`. Other origins are not allowed. `GET /workflows` without `x-demo-key` is still 401.
- Tests added: `apps/api/src/cors.test.ts` — allowed preflight, rejected origin, unauthenticated GET still 401, authenticated GET includes the allow-origin header.
- Implementation: `@fastify/cors` registered in `buildApp` before the demo-key hook.
- Files changed:
  - `apps/api/src/cors.test.ts`
  - `apps/api/src/app.ts`
  - `apps/api/package.json`
  - `package-lock.json`
- Verification:
  - focused: `npm test -w @kisi-workflow/api -- src/cors.test.ts` → pass (4 tests; failed first on 401, then passed)
  - suite: `npm test -w @kisi-workflow/api` → pass (16 files, 136 tests)
  - typecheck: `npm run typecheck` → pass
  - build: `npm run build` → pass
